messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High error rate and latency detected for customer Aurum (VPC: aurum-prod-eu). Dedicated pool dp-eu-aurum-1 reporting 5xx > 40% and p95 > 2s. Paging SRE rotation now.

monitoring-bot: snapshot: 5xx spike start=3923456740, peak 42%, sustained 15m. Node OOM events correlated.

maria: ack — taking triage. What nodes are flapping? any recent deploys or host-image updates?

oncall-rotation-bot: oncall hand: taylor -> taking in 2m. maria please forward findings.

maria: quick notes: no code deploys to customer pool in last 24h. Seeing repeated OOM-kill on llm-worker processes + kube-proxy restarts on hosts host-eu-aurum-03 and host-eu-aurum-04. Network plugin (calico) restarts also seen. Logs: 
```
Mar 15 01:12:03 host-eu-aurum-03 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 2345 (llm-worker) score 1000
Mar 15 01:12:04 kubelet[...]: eviction signal: memory.available < threshold
Mar 15 01:12:05 calico-node[...]: Restarting BPF dataplane
```
Seems like host-image kernel update landed in the last maintenance window and may have changed oom_score_adj behavior on our cgroups.

taylor: I'm taking the bridge. Starting live mitigation: cordon host-eu-aurum-03, drain user pods (priority: aurum tenants), route traffic to dp-eu-burst-2 fallback pool while we stabilize. Spinning up warm instances for the KV cache for aurum.

ops-bot: relocate job started: `rcli relocate --tenant aurum --from dp-eu-aurum-1 --to dp-eu-burst-2 --parallel 3 --id relocate-3923456789`

elaine: CS note: contacting Aurum CSM and AM now. Telling them we have a mitigation in progress, ETA 20-30m for stabilization. Preparing exec notice.

maria: mitigation detail — on host-eu-aurum-04 we observed a kernel OOM behavior change that caused memory compaction to fail and the oom_killer to prefer our llm-worker. Quick mitigation: bump container memory reservation (cgroup limit from 90% to 95%) for critical llm-workers on the remaining hosts and increase eviction thresholds. Also initiated kernel rollback on host-eu-aurum-03/04.

taylor: running small-model fallback to preserve availability: toggled model routing for aurum to use `redwood-lambda-small` for non-critical calls to reduce memory footprint. This is live.

ops-bot: relocate job complete: 3 pods moved, KV warmup done (prefetch complete). Job logs: `relocate-3923456789: success`.

maria: metrics update: p95 latency down from 2.4s -> 0.95s, 5xx down to ~2.5% over last 6m. Network plugin restarts stopped after kernel rollback on host-eu-aurum-03.

monitoring-bot: alert: incident state -> mitigated.

taylor: marking myself as lead for post-incident followups. Timeline for RCA will be on me + maria + ops. Please capture timelines and commands used.

samir: product/ops ask: need a concise exec summary and proposed customer credit calculation. Maria/taylor — please include impact window, affected endpoints, estimated failed requests/tokens, and mitigation steps. Elaine, coordinate customer-facing comm.

elaine: draft customer comm (to CSM/Aurora): "We experienced a service disruption for your Aurum VPC between 01:12–01:30 UTC on Mar 15. Root cause: a host kernel behavior change after an automated host-image update which caused OOM kills of inference workers on a subset of dedicated hosts. Impact: increased error rate and higher latency for text-generation endpoints. Mitigation: we relocated traffic to a fallback pool, performed kernel rollback, and applied temporary cgroup adjustments to stop evictions. Next steps: full RCA, remediation plan, and proposed SLA credit of 5% of the monthly bill for the affected window. Would you like an on-call postmortem meeting?"

maria: impact estimates: affected window 01:12–01:30 UTC. ~18 minutes of elevated errors; approx 3,100 failed requests (text-gen), ~1.2M tokens impacted. No customer data exfiltration.

samir: proposed credit: 5% monthly service credit for the billing period covering the incident, plus a dedicated follow-up call. Filing for approval from revenue ops.

devops: follow-ups (action items):
- infra-image: add canary gate for kernel-related host-image changes (owner: infra-image)
- runtime: add preflight kill-signal test and eviction spike alert (owner: runtime)
- platform: expand fallback warm pools for dedicated tenants with > 10% traffic (owner: platform)
- cs: prepare customer comm + offer sync (owner: elaine)

maria: notes for RCA draft: include exact kernel package versions, host agent logs, sequence of node OOMs, relocation commands used, and metrics graphs (p95, 5xx, pod restarts). I'll start the timeline section.

taylor: I'm adding runbook steps used (cordon/drain sequence, `rcli relocate` command, model routing toggle steps) to the incident doc. Please review.

ops-bot: incident resolved. Severity: sev2. Official mitigation time recorded 3923460345.

samir: I'll draft the exec summary and attach a short 2-paragraph note for the CEO/Sales leadership: impact, root cause, remediation plan, and customer credit. Will circulate for review by EOD.

elaine: CS to Aurum: sending soft-hold comm now; will wait for RCA before final credit language.

maria: final note — temporary mitigation requires permanent fixes: block automated kernel updates in dedicated pool images until canary pass is validated. Also add eviction spike trigger to paging rules to reduce MTTD for similar events.

oncall-rotation-bot: handoff complete. Keeping thread open for RCA comments and review.

incident-bot: thread closed for paging, keep discussion here for post-incident follow-up and RCA iterations.
